value.name: calls office line about estate
value.description: Lucia explains that she called Asha on the office line because the matter concerns the estate and she wanted to respect Asha's boundary about office calls.
evidence: "I did not want to tell you that on your cell because I remembered you said the office line was for office things, and this is, I suppose, an office thing, because it concerns the estate, although it does not concern any particular item of the estate."

value.name: Asha approves office-line call
value.description: Asha reassures Lucia that calling the office line was appropriate.
evidence: "I am glad you called the office line."

value.name: Daniel brings breakfast
value.description: Lucia reports that Daniel arrived with bagels and breakfast fixings.
evidence: "It is. He brought bagels and lox and cream cheese and capers and the small red onion sliced very thin"

value.name: Lucia recalls mother-like onion slicing
value.description: Lucia notices Daniel sliced the onion the way their mother used to, linking the breakfast to family memory.
evidence: "the small red onion sliced very thin, which is the way our mother used to slice it"

value.name: breakfast shifts to house discussion
value.description: Lucia says she and Daniel ate breakfast in the kitchen, avoided the house topic at first, then spent two hours discussing it.
evidence: "he set the table in the kitchen, not the dining room, and we ate breakfast and we did not talk about the house for the first forty minutes and then we talked about the house for two hours"

value.name: Daniel leaves after breakfast
value.description: After the long conversation, Daniel departs and Lucia remains alone in the kitchen with the dishes.
evidence: "and now he is gone and I am sitting in the kitchen looking at the plates"

value.name: Lucia confides in Asha
value.description: Lucia admits she wanted to tell Asha about the breakfast and conversation because Asha is the person she most wanted to tell.
evidence: "I wanted to tell someone, and the someone I wanted to tell was you"

value.name: Lucia acknowledges feelings for Asha
value.description: Lucia recognizes that wanting to tell Asha carries emotional meaning and says so openly.
evidence: "I am aware of what that means and I am telling you anyway because you said to be honest with you and I am being honest with you."

value.name: Asha sets professional boundary
value.description: Asha responds gently but firmly that she cannot be Lucia's confidante while serving as the estate lawyer.
evidence: "I am glad you and your brother had breakfast. I am glad you talked. I cannot be the person you tell about it. Not yet. Not while I am the lawyer on this estate. After. If you want to, after."

value.name: Lucia accepts boundary
value.description: Lucia absorbs Asha's refusal without anger and agrees to it.
evidence: "There was a silence on the line that was not, Asha could tell, an angry silence. It was the silence of a person absorbing something she had half-expected."

value.name: Asha apologizes
value.description: Asha apologizes for setting the boundary, signaling regret even as she maintains it.
